item: Data identity and exact split IDs
evidence: Our ZIP/member/row IDs and hashes are pinned; HPC paths and 1,497 test rows do not establish byte-for-byte dataset/order identity. Need HPC train/dev/test hashes and row-ID/sequence-hash tables.
Both evaluator definitions use numeric class 1 for binary AUROC. Biological code-to-class mapping remains unavailable.

Ours is hash-pinned official original Evo2-1B; historical eval resolves `evo2_1b_base_mbridge/iter_0000001`, whose bytes, upstream parent and checksums are absent. Model names do not prove equivalence.
Need immutable upstream weight revision/hash, converter code revision, command/config, tensor mapping and precision lineage.

Ours is verified ASCII CharLevelTokenizer(512), pad1/eos0, no BOS/EOS insertion. BioNeMo names nucleotide_fast_tokenizer_512 and tokenizes via HuggingFaceTokenizer; actual tokenizer assets, automatic special-token behavior and token-ID parity are absent.

Ours right-pads to a multiple of 16; BioNeMo code preallocates a fixed 1,000-token input. Both mask padding for pooling by definition, but numerical equivalence has not been measured. Actual supplied H3 sequences are at most 500nt.
Both definitions mean-pool positions selected by a nonpadding mask. Token parity is an unresolved prerequisite.

Ours hooks `norm` after final RMSNorm. BioNeMo pools `self.decoder(...)` output. Need exact installed decoder implementation/config to establish normalization location; a comment “last layer” is insufficient.

Ours uses pinned Vortex FP8 input projections with original weights and CPU-float32 heads; BioNeMo log uses H200/Megatron-Bridge, BF16 and tensorwise FP8 metadata, distributed optimizer. No cross-backend numerical tolerance test exists.

Pinned source specifies LayerNorm1920/Linear1920/GELU/Dropout0.1/Linear2, linear Normal std1/sqrt(fan-in), zero bias, matching our independent head definition. Exact historical checkpoint head tensors/config still require verification.
Ours is CPU AdamW; BioNeMo constructs distributed fused Adam with matching LR/beta/epsilon/zero-weight-decay settings, but numerical update equivalence is not established.

item: Steps, batch and initial LR settings
evidence: Actual H3 training log: 300 steps, global batch8, LR1e-3, min LR1e-4, warmup20. Intended launcher 750/64/3e-4 arguments were never passed.
At step250 our LR is0.000168974; logged BioNeMo LR is0.000129243. BioNeMo reaches minimum at iteration280, while ours reaches it at300. Matching endpoints is insufficient.

Ours is reconstructed uniform replacement (selected250:2,000 draws/1,842 unique rows). BioNeMo reports cyclic dataloader and2,400 consumed samples at300; exact unique rows/order and sampler state are absent.
Ours seed42; actual H3 training config and initialization log both record1234. Exact training RNG state still requires checkpoint/config evidence.
Our independent MLP selected250 by dev AUROC; BioNeMo evaluation stderr resolves head `iter_0000300`. Need its immutable files and selection record, not just a parent directory path.
Our six-checkpoint dev-AUROC rule is recorded. Historical parent-directory auto-resolution does not establish dev-based selection.
Ours is probability_class1 >=0.5; historical evaluator uses argmax over two logits, which differs on an exact tie (class0). Away from ties they coincide.
Both report class1 softmax AUROC and fraction correct. This does not imply matching inputs or fitted heads.

Ours scores causal next-nucleotide likelihood, aggregates by valid targets and exponentiates NLL. Historical classifier log “ce loss PPL” exponentiates classification loss; it is not language-model perplexity.

Eval stdout lists missing head keys during a checkpoint load. Current source has separate base-load and head-overlay stages; the warning alone neither proves failed head overlay nor validates it. Need exact run_config, loader revision, load audit and actual trained head tensors.
